newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares fall as Chidambaram not in cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares fall as Chidambaram not in cabinet.

text.p: Delhi shares opened lower on Monday on nervous selling triggered by news that P. Chidambaram, outgoing finance minister, was not included in Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's cabinet, brokers said.
The Delhi bourse's benchmark index was 4.60 points down at 777.44 after 30 minutes of trade.
Bharat Bhushan of brokers Nu-Era Securities said operators sold heavily on news that Chidambaram was not in Gujral's cabinet.

Gujral kept both the finance and foreign ministry portfolios for himself. Politicians said the new prime minister was still holding out hope that Chidambaram and his regional Tamil Maanila Congress party would join the government.
State Bank of India dropped 4.15 rupees to 300.
Oriental Bank of Commerce lost one rupee at 77.75.
Larsen and Toubro was down 2.50 rupees to 223.
